in_hebrew.name: Ewens
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ewens הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Ewens was the god of youth and brightness. In Christianity, it could be derived from the Aramaic name Elijah, which means 'my God is Jehovah'.
